data.title: US military strikes ship in Gulf of Oman, says it tried to breach Iran blockade | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: CENTCOM said the Palau-flagged Pacific Archer had left Iran’s Bandar Abbas port and ignored repeated warnings. The strike disabled the ship’s propulsion, but no crew members were injured.
data.keywords: Iran,United States,Donald Trump,blockade,Gulf of Oman,IRGC,Strait of Hormuz,USA,CENTCOM
